answer: Forging identities would require acquiring real forest parcels, making mass sybils costly. Sybil resistance here works by bonding each agent to a scarce physical resource: before joining, an agent must stake a registered timber lot whose harvest coordinates are verifiable and non-duplicable. A whisper network of peers cross-checks lot records at each jetty where timber ships, flagging duplicates before admission. Attackers must buy and maintain genuine parcels, so fake identities lose money. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
